texts: bad: the query hard-codes "cold_threshold_wind" as a knowledge-base symbol instead of looking the referent up by its kind, and it invents a measurement dimension called "wind" that no word of your question supplies, so it asks for a number on a scale nothing would ever have been stored under and cannot reach a definitional statement at all. We have no "what is X?" retrieval form, so name the kind of answer you want. For a classification, ask "What kind of thing is the cold-threshold wind?"; if what you want is its threshold value, name the dimension instead and ask "What temperature is the cold-threshold wind?" (or "What wind speed is the cold-threshold wind?"), which binds a stored measure cleanly.
